blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. Experiments on MANTIS-Bench show that MANTIS reduces the Union Attack Success Rate (UASR) by 3.55 percentage points relative to SheepDog on GossipCop and consistently outperforms prior single-axis defenses on Macro-F1 while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-axis and instance-adaptive worst-case training.
blocks.zh: 自动假新闻侦测在社交媒体上至关重要, 然而,现有方法通常依赖于表面的书写提示或单式文字重写,导致在各种化妆品修改下强度差. 我们构建了 MANTIS-Bench, 一个多轴的演示-攻击基准, 将原始新闻与重写的观点结合起来, 我们进一步提议MANTIS, 一种适应具体情况的对抗性框架, 这重新界定了假新闻辩护,从高压格式平滑地演变成目标明确,事实不一的可信度评估. MANTIS-Bench的实验显示,MANTIS在GossipCop上将联盟攻击成功率(UASR)相对于羊道克降低3.55个百分点,在Macro-F1上持续地超过之前的单轴防御,同时保持竞争性的清洁精度,证明了多轴和实例适应最坏情况训练的效果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustration of presentation-level vulnerability in fake news detection. Different presentation variations lead to inconsistent predictions from the same detector.
blocks.zh: 图1:关于假新闻侦测中列报层面脆弱性的说明。 不同的表征变化导致同一探测器的预测不一致.

blocks.en:
Human credibility assessments frequently rely on surface shortcuts, readily equating fluent phrasing, professional syntax, and neutral tone with factual truth Reber and Schwarz (1999) . The rise of large language models (LLMs) enables malicious actors to mass-produce deceptive claims wrapped in such authoritative packaging at near-zero cost Goldstein et al. (2023) , severely amplifying public cognitive biases and undermining social trust Lazer et al. (2018) . Automated fake news detection has therefore emerged as an essential safeguard for online information integrity Guo et al. (2022) .
However, static benchmark performance does not reflect robustness to changes in presentation, with these models easily fall into shortcut learning Geirhos et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2024a) , latching onto superficial presentation patterns such as stylistic tone or emotional intensity rather than verifying underlying factual claims. This reliance on presentation cues can lead to inconsistent predictions when writing style or emotional expression changes, even if the underlying claims remain unchanged Wu et al. (2024) ; Tahmasebi et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh:
人类可信度评估经常依靠地表捷径,容易将流利的语法、专业语法和中性语气等同于事实真相Reber和Schwarz (1999)。 大型语言模型(LLMs)的兴起使恶意行为者能够以接近零成本的Goldstein等人(2023年)在这种权威包装中大量产生欺骗性诉求,严重地扩大了公众认知偏见并破坏了社会信任Lazer等人(2018年). 因此,自动假新闻侦测已成为Guo等在线信息完整性的基本保障(2022年)。
然而,静态基准性能并不反映列报方式变化的稳健性,这些模型很容易落入捷径去学习Geirhos等人(2020年);Li等人(2024年a),紧贴表面的列报模式,如语气或情绪强度等,而不是核实基本的事实性说法。 这种对呈现提示的依赖会导致在写作风格或情感表达变化时出现不一致的预测,即使基本说法没有改变; Wu等 (2024).; Tahmasebi等 (2026).

blocks.en:
To mitigate presentation-level reliance, recent studies have developed defenses targeting writing style, such as SheepDog Wu et al. (2024) and AdStyle Park et al. (2025) , and sentiment, such as AdSent Tahmasebi et al. (2026) . However, robustness to a single perturbation family does not guarantee robustness to others Tramèr and Boneh (2019) ; Wang and Gan (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024) .
We argue that applying uniform rewrites across all samples may be suboptimal, as different instances can be vulnerable to different presentation transformations.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , separate changes to writing style, emotional expression, or dissemination framing can flip the detector’s prediction for the same news item from fake to real, while preserving its core claim.
Without explicitly such heterogeneous weaknesses, single-axis defenses may leave cross-axis blind spots and fail to adapt to the varied vulnerability patterns across individual news items.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻演示层的依赖,近期的研究发展出以写作风格为目标的防御方法,如羊道武等 (2024年)和AdStyle Park等 (2025年),以及情绪,如AdSent Tahmasebi等 (2026年). 然而,一个单一的扰动家庭的稳健性并不能保证其他人的稳健性,Tramèr和Boneh(2019年);Wang和Gan(2023年); 王等 (2024) (中文(简体) ).
我们主张,对所有样品采用统一重写可能不够理想,因为不同的情况可能易受不同的列报转变的影响。
如图1所示,对写作风格、情感表达或传播框架的单独改变可以将探测器对同一新闻项目的预测从假变为真实,同时保留其核心主张。
单轴防线没有明确区分出这些不同的弱点,就可能留下跨轴盲点,无法适应单个新闻项目的各种脆弱性模式。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early research on robust fake news detection has primarily focused on domain shifts, temporal drift, and spurious correlations. For instance, MDFEND Nan et al. (2021) and M 3 FEND Zhu et al. (2023) learn multi-view representations for domain heterogeneity, FTT Hu et al. (2023) models temporal trends for future adaptation, and ENDEF Zhu et al. (2022) uses causal debiasing to alleviate entity shortcuts.However, these methods have not explicitly addressed presentation-level shortcuts that can affect veracity predictions when claim-preserving textual changes are made.
blocks.zh: 关于强力假新闻检测的早期研究主要集中于域位移,时间漂移,和虚假的关联. 例如,MDFEND Nan等人(2021年)和M 3 FEND Zhu等人。 (2023) 为域异性学习多视图表达式, FTT 胡等编. (2023)模拟未来适应的时间趋势,以及ENDEF Zhu等. (2022)使用因果解析来缓解实体快捷键. 然而,这些方法并未明确涉及列报层面的快捷方式,这些快捷方式在作出保留权利要求的文字修改时可能影响真实性的预测。

blocks.en: To mitigate presentation-level vulnerabilities, recent studies have explored adversarial training and LLM-based augmentation. Recent approaches target style robustness through SheepDog Wu et al. (2024) and AdStyle Park et al. (2025) , or sentiment-related vulnerabilities through AdSent Tahmasebi et al. (2026) . Despite their effectiveness on individual axes, these defenses do not explicitly consider instance-specific worst-case variants within a unified multi-axis space, motivating MANTIS to address complementary presentation vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻介绍层面的脆弱性,最近的研究探讨了对抗性培训和基于LLM的增强。 最近的方法通过SheepDog Wu等人(2024年)和AdStyle Park等人(2025年),或通过AdSent Tahmasebi等人(2026年),与情绪有关的脆弱性,达到目标风格稳健性。 尽管这些辩护在单个轴线上是有效的,但这些辩护并没有在统一的多轴空间内明确考虑针对具体实例的最坏情况变体,从而激励MANTIS解决互补的演示脆弱性.

blocks.en: The development of LLMs has expanded fake news detection and veracity evaluation by leveraging LLMs as reasoning engines and explanation generators. FakeGPT Huang and Sun (2023) analyzes prediction consistency, ARG Hu et al. (2024) incorporates LLM-generated rationales to assist task-specific detectors, and FactAgent Li et al. (2024b) conducts multi-step structured verification via external tools. Further studies integrate domain knowledge and reasoning traces into detection pipelines through heterogeneous news–entity–topic graphs Ma et al. (2024) , negative reasoning Zhang et al. (2025) , and persuasion-aware prompting strategies Modzelewski et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 有限责任公司的发展通过利用有限责任公司作为推理引擎和解释生成器,扩大了假新闻检测和真实性评价。 假 GPT 软件 Huang and Sun (2023)分析预测一致性,ARG Hu等. (2024年)纳入了LLM生成的理由,以协助任务特定探测器,FactAgent Li等(2024年b)通过外部工具进行多步骤结构化核查. 进一步的研究通过各种新闻-实体-专题图表Ma等(2024年)、负面推理Zhang等(2025年)和劝导策略Modzelewski等(2025年),将域内知识和推理痕迹纳入探测管道。

blocks.en: However, LLM-assisted detection still faces challenges in presentation robustness and inference efficiency. First , LLM-based detectors remain sensitive to stylistic or emotional changes even when factual claims remain unchanged Wu et al. (2024) ; Tahmasebi et al. (2026) . Second , frameworks rely on multi-stage inference, including tool-assisted verification and persuasion analysis Li et al. (2024b) ; Modzelewski et al. (2025) , may increase inference costs. Our MANTIS confines multi-axis transformations and instance-wise worst-case optimization to offline training and performs single-pass inference without additional rewriting or tool calls.
blocks.zh: 然而,LLM辅助检测在列报稳健性和推论效率方面仍然面临挑战. 首先,基于LLM的探测器仍然对结构或情绪变化敏感,即使事实上的主张没有改变;Wu等(2024);Tahmasebi等(2026)。 第二,框架依赖于多阶段推论,包括工具辅助核查和说服分析Li等人(2024年b);Modzelewski等人(2025年),可能增加推论费用。 我们的MANTIS将多轴转换和实例最坏情况优化限制在离线训练中,并进行单通推论,无需额外的重写或工具呼叫.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: MANTIS combines multi-axis news transformations with instance-wise worst-case training. As illustrated in Figure 2 , an LLM rewriter generates six offline views under claim-preservation constraints. During training, MANTIS selects the highest-loss view for each case and optimizes the detector using both original and selected views. At inference time, it performs a single forward pass without additional rewriting.
blocks.zh: MANTIS将多轴新闻转换与实例最坏情况培训相结合. 如图2所示,LLM重写机在索赔-保留限制下产生6个离线视图。 在训练期间,MANTIS为每个案例选择最高损耗视图,并同时使用原创和所选视图来优化探测器. 在推论中,它执行一个单一的前行传,而不进行额外的重写.

blocks.zh: 3.2 曼提斯-奔驰

blocks.en: MANTIS-Bench pairs original news with rewritten views generated under core-claim preservation constraints to evaluate detector robustness to presentation changes. Existing studies have examined publisher-conditioned writing style through style transformations and robust training Wu et al. (2024) ; Park et al. (2025) , sentiment and emotional expression through sentiment manipulation Tahmasebi et al. (2026) , and persuasive language or explicit calls to action in misinformation and social-media communication Modzelewski et al. (2025) ; Rogers et al. (2019) . However, these presentation factors have generally been formulated and evaluated separately. We bring them into a unified transformation space comprising writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing.

blocks.en: To determine whether the three dimensions expose complementary vulnerabilities, we conduct a diagnostic study on the GossipCop test set using four LLM detectors; full experimental details are provided in Section 4 . Fake news is transformed separately using T S m T_{S}^{m} , T E n T_{E}^{n} , and T D − T_{D}^{-} , whereas real news is transformed using the opposite directions T S t T_{S}^{t} , T E s T_{E}^{s} , and T D + T_{D}^{+} . blocks.en: 3.3 The MANTIS Framework

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction and Quality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设和质量评价

blocks.en: Data Sources and Splits. We construct MANTIS-Bench from PolitiFact, GossipCop, and Weibo21, with dataset statistics summarized in Table 1 . PolitiFact and GossipCop are collected from FakeNewsNet Shu et al. (2020) , covering political and entertainment news, respectively. Following SheepDog Wu et al. (2024) , we adopt balanced temporal splits for both datasets, where the most recent 20% of cases within each label constitute the test set. Weibo21 Nan et al. (2021) is used exclusively for cross-lingual evaluation. We combine the official splits and construct a topic-balanced evaluation subset containing 1,350 cases from nine topics, with 75 real and 75 fake cases per topic.
blocks.zh: 数据源与分块. 我们从PoliticFact、GossipCop和微博21构建了MANTIS-Bench,数据集统计数据汇总于表1。 PoliticFact和GossipCop则取自"假新闻网"Shu等. (2020年),分别报道政治新闻和娱乐新闻. 跟着羊狗 Wu等人(2024年),我们对两个数据集采用均衡的时间分数,其中每个标签中最近20%的病例构成测试集. Weibo21 Nan等 (2021)专用于跨语言评价. 我们合并了官方的划分,并构建了一个专题均衡评价子集,包含9个专题的1 350个案例,每个专题有75个真实案例和75个假案例。

blocks.en: View Generation. Transformations for the two English datasets, PolitiFact and GossipCop, are generated with GPT-5-mini Singh et al. (2025) , whereas transformations for the Chinese Weibo21 dataset are generated with DeepSeek-V4-Flash Xu et al. (2026) . Following the transformations defined in Section 3.2 , each rewriting request combines a shared claim-preservation instruction, a target-specific instruction, and the original news without providing its veracity label to the generator. Each rewritten view is paired with its source article and inherits the original label. Full prompts are provided in Appendix A . We examine factual-claim preservation through both human evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge assessment.
blocks.zh: 观出世相. "PoliticFact"和"GossipCop"这两个英文数据集的变换由GPT-5-mini Singh等生成(2025),而"中国微博21"数据集的变换由DeepSeek-V4-Flash Xu等生成(2026). 在第3.2节所定义的转换之后,每一份重写请求将共享的索赔保留指示、目标特定指示和原始新闻结合起来,而不向生成者提供其真实性标签。 每个重写视图都与其源文章相配并继承了原标签. 附录A提供了全部提示。 我们通过人力评估和作为法官的LLM来审查事实索赔保全。

blocks.en: Human Evaluation. We sampled 60 original–transformed pairs across three datasets: 30 English pairs from PolitiFact and GossipCop, and 30 Chinese pairs from Weibo21, with balanced real and fake cases across each transformation dimension. Two annotators independently evaluated all pairs on two criteria: claim preservation (retaining original factual claims) and target realization (exhibiting the intended presentation shift). Inter-annotator agreement reached 95.0% ( κ = 0.79 \kappa=0.79 ) for claim preservation and 93.3% ( κ = 0.76 \kappa=0.76 ) for target realization. Following consensus resolution of disagreements, 58 of 60 pairs (96.7%) preserved factual claims, 57 of 60 (95.0%) realized the target transformation, and 56 of 60 (93.3%) satisfied both criteria.
blocks.zh: 人文评价. 我们从三个数据集中抽取了60对原生的-变形对:30对来自PolitiaFact和GossipCop的英文对;30对来自微博21的中文对;每个变形维度都有均衡的真假相克. 两名注释员根据两项标准独立评估了所有对子:索赔保全(保留原事实索赔)和目标实现(排除预期的列报方式转变)。 公证员之间达成协议95.0%(=0.79\kappa=0.79),要求保全93.3%(=0.76\kappa=0.76),要求实现目标. 在协商一致解决了分歧之后,60对索赔中有58对(96.7%)保留了事实索赔,60对(95.0%)中有57对实现了目标转变,60对(93.3%)中有56对符合这两项标准。

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-Judge. Following the human evaluation, we present the same 60 cases to independent LLM judges and ask whether each transformed view preserves the factual claims of the corresponding original news. DeepSeek-V4-Flash evaluates the English cases generated by GPT-5-mini, while GPT-5-mini evaluates the Chinese cases generated by DeepSeek-V4-Flash. With the human annotations withheld throughout the judging process, we quantify agreement between the resulting LLM decisions and the corresponding human labels using Cohen’s Kappa. The overall score of 0.79 indicates substantial agreement after accounting for chance.
blocks.zh: LLM -as 人类评价后,我们向独立的LLM法官提交同样的60个案件,并询问每个转变后的观点是否保留了相应原始新闻的事实说法. DeepSeek-V4-Flash评价由GPT-5-mini生成的英文病例,而GPT-5-mini评价由DeepSeek-V4-Flash生成的中文病例. 我们用科恩的"卡帕"(Kappa)来量化所做出的LLM决定与相应的人类标签之间的一致。 0.79的总得分表明,在考虑机会之后,基本一致。

blocks.en: We compare MANTIS against baselines from three detector families:
blocks.zh: 我们比较了MANTIS与三个探测器家族的基线:

blocks.en: • Supervised encoders. This group includes BERT Devlin et al. (2019) , RoBERTa Liu et al. (2019) , and DeBERTa He et al. (2020) . Each model is fine-tuned on the original English training cases and serves as a standard supervised baseline without explicit robustness training. • Zero-shot LLMs. This group includes Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Qwen et al. (2025) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) , Qwen3-8B Yang et al. (2025) , GLM-4-9B Glm et al. (2024) , Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct Qwen et al. (2025) , Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) , and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Xu et al. (2026) . All models receive the same binary classification prompt and directly predict whether the input news is real or fake without task-specific fine-tuning. These baselines assess the robustness of general-purpose LLMs to presentation transformations. • Robust fake news detectors. This group includes SheepDog Wu et al. (2024) and AdSent Tahmasebi et al. (2026) . SheepDog targets adversarial writing-style variations, whereas AdSent reduces reliance on sentiment-related cues. We reproduce both methods using their public implementations and evaluate them on the same original and transformed views as MANTIS. Their performance on the respective adversarial test sets introduced in the original studies is reported separately to assess generalization beyond our transformation settings.

blocks.en: 4.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.4 详细执行情况

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented with PyTorch 2.4.1. The supervised models are trained for five epochs using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and a batch size of 4; their results are averaged over ten random seeds. Zero-shot LLM inference is performed in BF16 using the same classification prompt and label space for all models. MANTIS is built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and trained with LoRA using rank 32 and α = 64 \alpha=64 . We use AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduces MANTIS-Bench and MANTIS for robust fake news detection under claim-preserving presentation changes. MANTIS-Bench pairs original news with complementary views along writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing, while MANTIS adapts robust training to each case by optimizing the original view together with its most challenging transformed view. Experiments on PolitiFact and GossipCop demonstrate strong performance across both original and transformed news, together with consistently lower UASR. Evaluations on the SheepDog publisher-style attacks further demonstrate transfer to unseen style transformations, while the Weibo21 results show improved, although still challenging, cross-lingual generalization. Overall, our findings demonstrate the importance of multi-axis evaluation and case-specific robust training for reliable fake news detection.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍MANTIS-Bench和MANTIS在索赔保留演示文稿修改下进行强力假新闻检测. MANTIS-Bench将原创性新闻与补充性观点结合到写作风格,情感表达,传播框架上,而MANTIS则通过优化原创性观点及其最具挑战性的转变后观点来适应每个案例的强力训练. 关于PoliticFact和GossipCop的实验表明,无论是在原始新闻还是变形新闻方面,以及一贯较低的UASR,都表现得非常出色。 对"羊道克"出版商风格攻击的评价进一步证明了向"隐形"风格转变的转变,而"微博21"的结果显示,虽然仍然具有挑战性,但"跨语言通论"有所改进. 总体而言,我们的调查结果表明,必须开展多轴评价和针对具体案例的有力培训,以便进行可靠的假新闻检测。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: MANTIS considers three presentation dimensions and operates over a finite set of six offline LLM-generated views. Although these views cover complementary changes in writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing, they cannot represent every presentation variation encountered in practice. Moreover, the human evaluation covers only a limited subset of the generated views, and occasional generation artifacts may remain despite the supporting human and LLM-based quality assessments. Our evaluation is also restricted to three benchmark datasets, and the moderate absolute performance on Weibo21 indicates that simultaneous shifts in language, domain, and topic remain challenging. Future work could extend MANTIS to broader languages and domains, additional presentation dimensions, multimodal news, and dynamically constructed transformation neighborhoods.
blocks.zh: MANTIS考虑三个演示维度,运行于由6个离线LLM生成的有限集. 虽然这些观点涵盖写作风格、情感表达和传播框架方面的互补变化,但它们不能代表实际中遇到的每一种表述变化。 此外,人类评价只涵盖有限部分所产生的观点,尽管有支持性的人文和LLM质量评估,但偶尔产生的一代人文物可能仍然存在。 我们的评价也仅限于三个基准数据集,微博21上适度的绝对性能表明,语言,域名和主题的同步转变仍然具有挑战性. 今后的工作可以将MANTIS扩展至更广泛的语言和领域、额外的展示内容、多式新闻和动态构建的转型街区。

blocks.en: B.1 Dataset Composition and Topic-Balanced Sampling
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集的组成和专题抽样

blocks.en: The official Weibo21 release Nan et al. (2021) contains 5,751 training, 1,918 validation, and 1,923 test cases, comprising 9,592 cases in total. It provides nine named topics together with an additional undetermined category. Table 6 reports the distribution of these categories across the three official splits.
blocks.zh: 官方微博21发布"南等"(2021)包含5,751个培训,1,918个鉴定,1,923个测试案例,共包括9,592个案例. 它提供了9个被命名的专题,并增加了一个未确定的类别。 表6报告这些类别在三种正式划分的分布情况。

blocks.en:
Table 6: Topic distribution of the original Weibo21 dataset and the topic-balanced subset used in our evaluation.
Val. denotes the official validation split.
blocks.zh:
表6:我们评价中使用的原始微博21数据集和专题平衡子集的专题分布.
Val.表示官方验证分出.

blocks.en: Because Weibo21 is used exclusively for evaluation, we pool its three official splits before constructing the topic-balanced subset. We exclude the undetermined category, remove duplicated news and duplicates with conflicting topic annotations. Using a fixed sampling seed of 2027, we select 75 real and 75 fake cases from each of the nine named topics. The resulting evaluation set contains 150 cases per topic and 1,350 cases in total. The same cases are used to construct the style, emotion, and dissemination views for all evaluated detectors.
blocks.zh: 因为微博21专用于评价,所以在构建专题平衡子集之前,我们集中了它的三个官方分集. 我们排除了未确定的类别,删除了重复的新闻并重复了相互矛盾的专题说明. 我们使用2027年的固定采样种子,从9个被命名的专题中分别选择了75个真实和75个假病例. 由此产生的评价包括每个专题的150个案例和总共1 350个案例。 同样的案例也被用来构建所有被评价的探测器的风格,情感和传播观点.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct achieves the strongest performance on the original, emotion, and dissemination views, whereas Qwen3-8B performs best under the style transformation. Nevertheless, all four models exhibit substantially lower Macro-F1 on at least one transformed view than on the original news. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is the most sensitive overall, with a UASR of 62.61%. GLM-4-9B obtains the lowest UASR, but this result should be interpreted together with its comparatively low original-view and transformed-view performance because UASR conditions only on originally correct cases.
